policy.rule: A capability is verified only when its contract test passed through the NESS public runtime path on the listed environment. A new FabricPC release is never blessed by import success; follow docs/FABRICPC_UPGRADE.md.

entries.accelerator_runtime: XLA CPU (JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu); 2 host devices forced with XLA_FLAGS=--xla_force_host_platform_device_count=2 for the multi-device leg
entries.data_parallel: verified (tests/fabricpc_backend/test_fabricpc_multidevice.py::test_data_parallel_matches_single_device_on_two_forced_cpu_devices: grads/loss/predictions identical to <1e-9, odd batch refused)

bp_algorithms_verified: fabricpc_bp_through_inference with fabricpc_feedforward (== PDF ff_bp; gradient parity with the NESS jax backend to 1e-8)

entries.test_artifact: pytest tests/fabricpc_backend tests/test_bootstrap_import_order.py tests/test_jax_backend_sharded.py: 36 passed, 1 skipped (2-GPU leg) on 2026-09-26
known_issues: Target-free sPC/ePC settling on an acyclic workspace with FeedforwardStateInit is the feedforward prediction (equilibrium at init); use state_init: global_normal or the recurrent profile for settling to change the deployed prediction.
fabricpc_pc_local requires all-true outcome masks (FabricPC energies are per sample).
InferenceSchedule (composed ePC->sPC) is not exposed by NESS plugins yet (experimental).
